name: Paradox
tagline: Paradox is a conversational AI recruiting platform whose AI assistant, Olivia, automates candidate screening, interview scheduling, and FAQ responses via text message. It helps high-volume hiring teams in retail, hospitality, and healthcare reduce time-to-hire significantly.
